method.selection: Only two resources were accepted because they fill the two categories that had fewer lessons than the other main themes. Quantity was not used as a target.
method.sentencePolicy: Strict sentence-level segmentation by terminal punctuation. Coordinated phrases and comma-linked clauses remain together; no duration cap was applied.
qualityChecks: base.en word-timestamp alignment against corrected source text
independent tiny.en ASR on every final sentence segment
manual review of model disagreements at sentence boundaries
RMS level, peak, clipping, DC offset, silence, and waveform-jump checks
explicit verification that long silence occurs only between the instruction and lecture body

notes: The 37 indexed candidates come from the through-4.29 and 5.3-6.2 collections and remain after this round because the two accepted resources came from the separate Pack collection.
